github_id.description: The users GitHub account ID if linked.

mxid.description: The user's matrix ID, if it exists

job_title.description: The user's job title at the organization.

interests.description: A list of the user's interests.

working_groups_interests.description: A list of the user's working group interests.

opt_in.description: Optional features that users have opted into for their account

public_fields.description: A list of the user's public fields.

mail_history.description: A list of the user's email history.

mail_alternate.description: A list of the user's alternate emails.

gerrit_url.description: The user's Gerrit URL, deprecated and always empty

signed.description: Flag determining whether user has signed ECA.

can_contribute_spec_project.description: Flag determining whether users can contribute to a spec project.

Error.description: An array containing a single message indicating the error

organization_name.description: The legal name of the organization

start.description: Start or entry date of the user employment

EditBugs.description: Edit bugs status. 1 for true, 0 for false
